sources.snippet: NB-Whisper Small Introducing the Norwegian NB-Whisper Small model, proudly developed by the National Library of Norway. NB-Whisper is a cutting-edge series of models designed for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation. These models are based on the work of OpenAI's Whisper.
